en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Bukeyr Bin Ayn who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Is it Permissible to buy the green plants?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, there is no problem with it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Bukayr ibn ‘A‘yan who has said the following:
“Upon my asking abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about buying a plantation when it only is green, he (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
